title: Level 6 Diploma in Management
description: Develop advanced management expertise in leadership, finance, marketing, entrepreneurship, human resources, strategy, and organisational performance.
longDescription: This Level 6 Diploma in Management provides learners with advanced knowledge of management, business, economics, finance, marketing, human resources, entrepreneurship, and organisational performance. The programme integrates core management disciplines with contemporary areas such as digital HR, artificial intelligence, performance management, professional ethics, and business etiquette. Learners develop analytical and decision-making capabilities through the study of accounting, finance, statistics, mathematics, microeconomics, macroeconomics, and government regulation of the economy. The programme also develops professional, academic, communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills through academic writing, business English, community service learning, and practical internships. Learners are prepared to apply management theories and practices in real organisational environments and to progress towards senior management roles or higher-level academic and professional qualifications. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 240 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners. The Program is delivered by one of GSS Partners.
courseDetails: Critically evaluate contemporary management theories, leadership approaches, organisational practices, and business environments to support effective managerial decision-making. Analyse and apply principles of marketing, entrepreneurship, accounting, finance, economics, and statistics to address complex organisational and business challenges. Evaluate human resource management, digital HR, performance management, time management, professional ethics, and organisational behaviour practices to improve employee and organisational performance. Assess the impact of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and digital transformation, on management, business operations, decision-making, and organisational competitiveness. Develop and justify strategic and operational recommendations using appropriate research, analytical techniques, academic evidence, and professional judgement. Demonstrate professional competence, ethical awareness, communication, leadership, teamwork, and problem-solving skills through academic work, community engagement, and practical industrial experience. entry: Level 6 Diploma in Management, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details. The Program is delivered by one of GSS Partners.
progression: Upon completing the Level 6 Diploma in Management students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
